correctness.rationale: The exact ordered adaptive-pivot probability is Δ_ij/(S t_i), where S=tr K and t_i=S-(K²)_ii/K_ii. The last Schur complement trace det(K)/Δ_ij cancels Δ_ij, giving E=2det(K)/S sum_i 1/t_i. Inserting the spike identities yields the stated separable law. Each summand 1-L/[L+1+(L-1)w] has second derivative -2L(L-1)^2/[L+1+(L-1)w]^3<0; strict Jensen proves the unique balanced maximum and concavity/simplex vertices the axis minima. Direct exact rational Schur-complement enumeration of 16 independent matrices reproduced both stages, boundaries and 2-DPP benchmark. The one-step expectation K−K²/tr(K) is spectrally invariant, while dimension 2 has zero residual after two pivots. Limit L=1 has nonunique equality and is deliberately excluded.
residual_risks: Computational samples are finite and do not independently certify unquantified infinite-domain conditions.
